title: Team Race 2
briefing:
Frank: Join Billy and me after work. Solo time-trial stand-in for the team race; AI opponents await E-6 traffic. The source gives no time limit; 120 seconds is an authored adaptation limit. Follow the broad scenic pad gates down the east corridor, around the southern bend, then up the outer west side to the northern finish; AWD is not simulated.
The pad stands in for Pyrénées; its Boxster stands in for the 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 Coupé (993). Police, traffic, vehicle damage and opponents are not simulated.
